camel_example: aliyun tag GetPolicyEnableStatus --region cn-hangzhou --OpenType TAG_POLICY --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --UserType RD
description_en: Queries the status of the Tag Policy feature
kebab_example: aliyun tag get-policy-enable-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-type RD --open-type TAG_POLICY --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPolicyEnableStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Set the value to cn-shanghai
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The mode of the Tag Policy feature. This parameter specifies a filter condition for the query. Valid values:

USER: single-account mode
RD: multi-account mode

For more information about the modes of the Tag Policy feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/417434.html.

The value of this parameter is not case-sensitive
parameters.help_zh:
标签策略模式。用于查询的过滤条件。取值：

USER：单账号模式。
RD：多账号模式。

关于标签策略模式的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/417434.html。

参数取值不区分大小写
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en:
The enabling type. Valid values:

TAG_POLICY: the Tag Policy feature.
VERIFY_NO_TAG: the strong verification feature.
TAG_POLICY_NOTIFY: the notification feature that sends notifications for resources found to be non-compliant with the tag policy
parameters.help_zh:
开通类型。取值：  

TAG_POLICY：标签策略。 
VERIFY_NO_TAG：强校验能力。
TAG_POLICY_NOTIFY：标签策略不合规资源通知
parameters.name: open_type
